Do not return hashes; the host binds immutable hashes.", "context": {"title": "Notre-Dame de Paris", "unit": 15, "heading": "VII\nUNE NUIT DE NOCES", "previous_rows": [{"source_id": "fr86-u015-b0030", "target": "Она ответила отрицательным движением головы, и задумчивый взгляд её устремился на свод кельи.", "source_sha256": "419697d8c367ee1354b1d63b55ff457774fcf45d8556a4efc52ff49bcfc31742", "target_id": "ru-fr86-u015-b0030", "tag": "p", "target_sha256": "21964009ebf5b409d897f2c11a9eb9ddc538d2202567d9f90c967d0c6e64de16"}, {"source_id": "fr86-u015-b0031", "target": "«Чем это она, чёрт возьми, так занята?» — подумал Гренгуар и, посмотрев туда же, куда смотрела она, решил: «Не может быть, чтобы её внимание так поглощала гримаса этого каменного карлика, вырезанного в замковом камне свода. Чёрт побери, я могу выдержать сравнение!»", "source_sha256": "2ce854f8cdd654d7ac7242d13fa16cec16ef122b770033253b0a2910d69a33c8", "target_id": "ru-fr86-u015-b0031", "tag": "p", "target_sha256": "eff05fa8e68b499b8887dfab7cffaf82a50b4549c374777968fa565f7f991448"}], "source_language": "French", "part": null, "book": 2, "chapter": 7, "role": "CHAPTER"}, "source_rows": [{"id": "fr86-u015-b0032", "text": "Il haussa la voix: «Mademoiselle!»", "sha256": "5359d95f29c41cfbe8a289e2f793ea90f35204b12bc85d0885dbc445abbb78b2", "role": "paragraph", "tag": "p", "source_physical_indices": [844], "source_xml_sha256": "289abe7679737c38d5fafc50fdc4c638e0150ba1f4a43970a1142ff4cc89196f", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr86-u015-b0033", "text": "Elle ne paraissait pas l'entendre.", "sha256": "a252c62f3247836cad69d9fb8d773b4263944784c5d78028cfb87093c305c114", "role": "paragraph", "tag": "p", "source_physical_indices": [845], "source_xml_sha256": "37e2d87de0bb8368958584e0948cfabf95c4c363b48b514c1efb0df6be9f3340", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr86-u015-b0034", "text": "Il reprit plus haut encore: «Mademoiselle Esmeralda!»", "sha256": "d990d5e9a51d24240510648a050d516ca4a532a8df52c04fd566966dc36bfc3a", "role": "paragraph", "tag": "p", "source_physical_indices": [846], "source_xml_sha256": "b866027d65c21c1b02bd30c68f258c956d90ba6ba71b12e6a90529af66785a54", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr86-u015-b0035", "text": "Peine perdue. L'esprit de la jeune fille était ailleurs, et la voix de Gringoire n'avait pas la puissance de le rappeler. Heureusement la chèvre s'en mêla. Elle se mit à tirer doucement sa maîtresse par la manche: «Que veux-tu, Djali? dit vivement l'égyptienne, comme réveillée en sursaut.", "sha256": "1f386d807cdbd0fcab89043e41f1982e8ad19093f7a37bf71b4e51f3f7a79968", "role": "paragraph", "tag": "p", "source_physical_indices": [847], "source_xml_sha256": "0785c3a533878abd7034ba4e358d48373e0a5f7def696d3afc59691f1ffc3096", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr86-u015-b0036", "text": "—Elle a faim,» dit Gringoire, charmé d'entamer la conversation.", "sha256": "9ff7dbc0074a27906c2a1d23e96dbae718a90c08d8ec0853ab1eada99504ffe6", "role": "paragraph", "tag": "p", "source_physical_indices": [848], "source_xml_sha256": "47398306993a9c873cb383c8bdbd3050c00c95b4a3b7fdda59c6dd6113d2e9dd", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr86-u015-b0037", "text": "La Esmeralda se mit à émietter du pain, que Djali mangeait gracieusement dans le creux de sa main.", "sha256": "ca7638418481312f978425308ea16d40828aea7c834252920db66724d05128d4", "role": "paragraph", "tag": "p", "source_physical_indices": [849], "source_xml_sha256": "968fa689093db2b5afb78941e4c70c5afc4700a40fd33e119a0682ef01280d5e", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr86-u015-b0038", "text": "Du reste, Gringoire ne lui laissa pas le temps de reprendre sa rêverie. Il hasarda une question délicate.", "sha256": "2b5162e28daa1d9a5ba1e9f2241d046135b6a9966b76b654f879e9b65d1acc4c", "role": "paragraph", "tag": "p", "source_physical_indices": [850], "source_xml_sha256": "601f65985be245f129908386c60dcc3135ed819559911fd8a317e87a1eb104d9", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr86-u015-b0039", "text": "«Vous ne voulez donc pas de moi pour votre mari?»", "sha256": "49279a735c0a1f9772a8bfb923988e47dc59c4a8ca38bce4c9cbdb93fd97180e", "role": "paragraph", "tag": "p", "source_physical_indices": [851], "source_xml_sha256": "3d32d39e099c8f1796202e359e8e46b17fd24bf349248d3d633511dd29b67a5e", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr86-u015-b0040", "text": "La jeune fille le regarda fixement, et dit: «Non.", "sha256": "aa4c4697be5bb3d154e1e8a829a3d6feb6df6464aacb2841a489c78ae638e171", "role": "paragraph", "tag": "p", "source_physical_indices": [852], "source_xml_sha256": "233780babe7e407ac898ba727ab93d9491bc99d8925940daf63411837543f6d7", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr86-u015-b0041", "text": "—Pour votre amant?» reprit Gringoire.", "sha256": "1d1c2bb6ce1ae9247d45e76748437c47f96629c71a7af85360f509b0b94c3c1a", "role": "paragraph", "tag": "p", "source_physical_indices": [853], "source_xml_sha256": "51c1651367f210cd948c924f27da72aa97295315e8c0be8c968faab48aaaab3c", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr86-u015-b0042", "text": "Elle fit sa moue, et répondit: «Non.", "sha256": "69c6f2274bb9cda6d15671b0c24965a9543217008d08508d92cc0c3fcd845dbe", "role": "paragraph", "tag": "p", "source_physical_indices": [854], "source_xml_sha256": "5012ef5ccc211d32e49b5a6552692fe39ca9a0d4fadfa828658836842d210c99", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr86-u015-b0043", "text": "—Pour votre ami?» poursuivit Gringoire.", "sha256": "fd84affcac9086ee913bde90c2a70513305ac94d3c6298793dcd4488a4921e5d", "role": "paragraph", "tag": "p", "source_physical_indices": [855], "source_xml_sha256": "41e8fe1f753b39e6d2584e63deafe543b1fad480b1c185ed5919e5a701326685", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr86-u015-b0044", "text": "Elle le regarda encore fixement, et dit après un moment de réflexion: «Peut-être.»", "sha256": "d500a6ec822aaa8edbd1a1e3aaa7fa0e96a5e01fcee07ad401518c588d4b359e", "role": "paragraph", "tag": "p", "source_physical_indices": [856], "source_xml_sha256": "029f58aff7dd2a55181ec3e1f78a83cf887e7f228b75cef866bc42e62e25ea26", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr86-u015-b0045", "text": "Ce [[I]]peut-être[[/I]], si cher aux philosophes, enhardit Gringoire.", "sha256": "61c95d1fe691e2c1d5c40e1f448a6cde5e539d5eb659f59221048c917a3ba578", "role": "paragraph", "tag": "p", "source_physical_indices": [857], "source_xml_sha256": "240723ee4d931d79e54147314d28c832abe88770c2df27c9b2dd1e15a97b91c6", "emphasis_spans": 1, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr86-u015-b0046", "text": "«Savez-vous ce que c'est que l'amitié? demanda-t-il.", "sha256": "2850bfac6a8aac66ecd749fbf3612180e1fe2e9547798b8e8719c6bc3e8334a1", "role": "paragraph", "tag": "p", "source_physical_indices": [858], "source_xml_sha256": "aabe802972fbb39ee5cb62bf55cc3370c45c93d0ce25656e874c4bff00afa795", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr86-u015-b0047", "text": "—Oui, répondit l'égyptienne. C'est être frère et sœur, deux âmes qui se touchent sans se confondre, les deux doigts de la main.", "sha256": "6552da1f60f73d3687f95a8f4cc13f83999a69d0503066b3961f66754b1aabc1", "role": "paragraph", "tag": "p", "source_physical_indices": [859], "source_xml_sha256": "da7532970748099ff80dfea5896f32772408c5c1eaf49542bdbf3d24798c5f9e", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr86-u015-b0048", "text": "—Et l'amour? poursuivit Gringoire.", "sha256": "c2bf5f57a4f60a60af32a53b310194a0a85d2e0a1f10a9d2ef081ad328e1996f", "role": "paragraph", "tag": "p", "source_physical_indices": [860], "source_xml_sha256": "02c6ef37b4446455972d04d7268a2c2c901e996bbff91b7deb511db935bba6df", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr86-u015-b0049", "text": "—Oh! l'amour! dit-elle, et sa voix tremblait, et son œil rayonnait. C'est être deux et n'être qu'un. Un homme et une femme qui se fondent en un ange. C'est le ciel.»", "sha256": "d9c9b1cf86e3e050e77f39dc18c7af19f3957e62e51819e218a79b97fbc5017d", "role": "paragraph", "tag": "p", "source_physical_indices": [861], "source_xml_sha256": "a951535e474f478dbf1a25689c7f3d88c309c6fb7a73aecaf3c3fa30209c2d49", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr86-u015-b0050", "text": "La danseuse des rues était, en parlant ainsi, d'une beauté qui frappait singulièrement Gringoire, et lui semblait en rapport parfait avec l'exaltation presque orientale de ses paroles. Ses lèvres roses et pures souriaient à demi; son front candide et serein devenait trouble par moments sous sa pensée, comme un miroir sous une haleine; et de ses longs cils noirs baissés s'échappait une sorte de lumière ineffable qui donnait à son profil cette suavité idéale que Raphaël retrouva depuis au point d'intersection mystique de la virginité, de la maternité et de la divinité.", "sha256": "d8f404327030c0119ad22ddbdd027d507dfdcc3868454923c55d6922b4819d62", "role": "paragraph", "tag": "p", "source_physical_indices": [862], "source_xml_sha256": "1bf3dedd86704e9638a6a5cf92f070af046d7c967992d00e0f1e4ff3cb6c55dc", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr86-u015-b0051", "text": "Gringoire n'en poursuivit pas moins.", "sha256": "8846573b2f51c623d52acf3b091f5facc26b891f8a8a2db9529c3244d1fa2c73", "role": "paragraph", "tag": "p", "source_physical_indices": [863], "source_xml_sha256": "1624a08b4d1913b7a7d93e385493cac3a09d442a0dd486c7484f0d0272f94785", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr86-u015-b0052", "text": "«Comment faut-il donc être pour vous plaire?", "sha256": "e9f9e92568b94350bd1fbe78827c78328b50e1ed2ccb05294d88f3877efba129", "role": "paragraph", "tag": "p", "source_physical_indices": [864], "source_xml_sha256": "46c6c6b21c1974f5b1b07d42a97c0aef5076751c8f09ccaa1cd2da639343c197", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr86-u015-b0053", "text": "—Il faut être homme.", "sha256": "fdadfd6b0281385bceba9b451fe82f585e29a0477539c1fcf9d51c21021d0fba", "role": "paragraph", "tag": "p", "source_physical_indices": [865], "source_xml_sha256": "3e7e617cb1f63d822848702bfd50eb359103ca3eb2e8d5d25b3dcc372deceece", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr86-u015-b0054", "text": "—Et moi, dit-il, qu'est-ce que je suis donc?", "sha256": "733aed1e69357d718efad630e4a656144ba7974e5948a4db495e8a2565b099ae", "role": "paragraph", "tag": "p", "source_physical_indices": [866], "source_xml_sha256": "93380d61b77c9575915e5bb3634c37d42365a5dd4bed3c96e36db5d906858162", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr86-u015-b0055", "text": "—Un homme a le casque en tête, l'épée au poing et des éperons d'or aux talons.", "sha256": "92693128975d00e3f759e7d546b57588f261508c42842597b66853bd1e8b3dea", "role": "paragraph", "tag": "p", "source_physical_indices": [867], "source_xml_sha256": "f2981859cc9720d3ee1d8a01634b962364cfd3eb9e5e263158c4b9df534928ae", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr86-u015-b0056", "text": "—Bon, dit Gringoire, sans le cheval point d'homme.—Aimez-vous quelqu'un?", "sha256": "a47a9d9df6438d024f65d32549f5701849dc0bfa429f496d41fb1200c381de0f", "role": "paragraph", "tag": "p", "source_physical_indices": [868], "source_xml_sha256": "4296c109c93e4626a7635dcc6d9126555f3870a12d666d87c820ab2abad6cfa2", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr86-u015-b0057", "text": "—D'amour?", "sha256": "81a9773ac680a10ebc04fdfe8889de496b24c7fe10db11dd5c114366c441b9a2", "role": "paragraph", "tag": "p", "source_physical_indices": [869], "source_xml_sha256": "4a04a69d7b941f1501b7bafeb91b17d581ff58dc0a50480eaa6e9d005f58a3cb", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr86-u015-b0058", "text": "—D'amour.»", "sha256": "4282459f49c44c4a9f51d01f26ddcc4f3ed850b93ea846a1aa2ff14fe63a4be5", "role": "paragraph", "tag": "p", "source_physical_indices": [870], "source_xml_sha256": "103b6904d05bfbea4e2d7788531a5fa2a4eeb63a0cb48467720f414ad664b8de", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr86-u015-b0059", "text": "Elle resta un moment pensive, puis elle dit avec une expression particulière: «Je saurai cela bientôt.", "sha256": "72ba20cbaa27248e02b131d8c3cb0e39ffd3f4d601271ec04ea1022782f324b5", "role": "paragraph", "tag": "p", "source_physical_indices": [871], "source_xml_sha256": "0bfe0dffb4154bd470d1e952e9a4741119c951f63657599a942eeb06530fcc5f", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr86-u015-b0060", "text": "—Pourquoi pas ce soir? reprit alors tendrement le poète. Pourquoi pas moi?»", "sha256": "7a0dff3c920766c727d4b2b077667a0f472d2c67ea69a737753d202ac2301f44", "role": "paragraph", "tag": "p", "source_physical_indices": [872], "source_xml_sha256": "14ad11c74654258f7f20705c909a5e2a91740097ad2a7066ec0e2303b7cce0d3", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr86-u015-b0061", "text": "Elle lui jeta un coup d'œil grave.", "sha256": "60ddd53af53f552d8582daa494daef87a8e241a4d04a81861bed520a5ac83f01", "role": "paragraph", "tag": "p", "source_physical_indices": [873], "source_xml_sha256": "40236e53a484f68b173f38e3fd2b3033ed824702b27295748e0eb6bd7680316d", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr86-u015-b0062", "text": "«Je ne pourrai aimer qu'un homme qui pourra me protéger.»", "sha256": "5715bb51db1e573a0b4e706056f1aca2ff1067134b1867ac1c02af2ad40d92f1", "role": "paragraph", "tag": "p", "source_physical_indices": [874], "source_xml_sha256": "32de6a32ed3a14211a1c6771c1d7960fc646969afcb2b0ae2956323fdb1b53d4", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr86-u015-b0063", "text": "Gringoire rougit et se le tint pour dit. Il était évident que la jeune fille faisait allusion au peu d'appui qu'il lui avait prêté dans la circonstance critique où elle s'était trouvée deux heures auparavant. Ce souvenir, effacé par ses autres aventures de la soirée, lui revint. Il se frappa le front.", "sha256": "d664f51179ebd815982b1a097199490726bb3e361eeac7508db1653c9e01066b", "role": "paragraph", "tag": "p", "source_physical_indices": [875], "source_xml_sha256": "644b629578a711417154b392cb0c7a66f5324341d5d4f9bf1812da9fbeb5a536", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}]}
